vendorContract.precedence: the vendor contract wins over the OmniRoute source where they differ

openapi.requestSchema: OCRRequest (application/json; required model and document; additionalProperties false)
openapi.errors: 422 HTTPValidationError is the only documented error

facts: document_url takes a public URL or a data:application/pdf;base64 URL; image_url takes an image URL or data:image/...;base64
accepted images include PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF and TIFF
table_format markdown or html returns tables separately instead of inline
extract_header / extract_footer move header and footer text out of the page content
uploaded documents must be 50 MB or less and 1,000 pages or fewer

intentionalContractChanges: only pages, image_limit and image_min_size are forwarded besides model and document; every other OCRRequest field is refused before sending because its output would be dropped or moved out of markdown
documents are rebuilt from the foundation's normalized form: DocumentURLChunk or ImageURLChunk with a string URL; document_name, image_url.detail and FileChunk file_id are refused by the foundation
the API key wins over an access token (source: accessToken || apiKey); this matches the staged Mistral STT adapter and the apikey-only mistral connection

the model list follows the vendor overview: mistral-ocr-4-1 and mistral-ocr-4 are added, mistral-ocr-latest is named Mistral OCR 4.1, and retired ids are refused instead of reaching the source prefix fallback
the answer keeps model, pages[].index, pages[].markdown and primitive usage_info values only

exports.mistralOcrAdapter: default frozen foundation adapter for provider mistral
exports.createMistralOcrDispatcher: (options) -> createOcrDispatcher with only the Mistral adapter; options { fetchImpl, sleepImpl, timeoutMs, maxResponseBytes }
exports.buildMistralOcrRequest: ({ model, document, options }) -> { url, method: POST, body }
exports.MISTRAL_OCR_MODELS: four current OCR model rows (kind ocr)

ocr.body: { model, document: { type: document_url|image_url, <type>: https URL or base64 data URL }, pages?, image_limit?, image_min_size? }

bounds: the foundation's: one 300 s deadline, 32 MiB answer cap, 50 MiB inline cap, redirects refused, no retries
